messages:
maria: Ran a 12h streaming-chat soak on staging with tool loops enabled. Mem graph looks like steady growth (~30MB/hr) after ~2h, not the usual plateau. Attaching quick heap diff and a couple of heapprofiles. @alex can you take a quick look? :eyes:

alex: Ack. Any repro steps? Which binary & flags?

maria: image: inference-runtime:prod-2027-03-12, flags: --kv-max-pages=20000 --enable-toolloop-kv=true --batcher=continuous. Repro: replay long-conversation script (link) with a 10-tool-chain turn frequency.

rachel: Poking at profiles now. Quick note: I see an increasing count in `kv_meta_map` entries in heap profile; total bytes per entry tiny but they don't get freed. Could be a metadata growth separate from page bodies.

maria: here's the stripped pprof snapshot (top lines):
```
heap 12h.snap  total 1.8GB
  320MB  17.8%  kv_meta_map (map[string]*kvMeta)
  280MB  15.5%  session_table (map[int64]*sessionState)
  190MB  10.5%  kv_page_pool (byte[])
  ...
```

tom: If kv_meta_map is growing we should check lifecycle: when pages are evicted, do we delete metadata? Sounds like a missing unlink. Any recent changes to eviction path?

maria: last change touching eviction was the async-evict refactor two weeks ago (PR #4128) which moved metadata cleanup to the background sweeper. Might be a race where sweeper skips items.

ken: I ran a targeted run with `--kv-evict-sync=true` (force sync cleanup) and growth flattened after gc cycle. That suggests background sweeper misses some entries under load.

rachel: Can we add instrumentation to count live meta refs vs pages? I want a time series of (pages_in_use, meta_entries, orphan_meta). Adding a counter for when page is freed and when meta removed.

maria: Created a small patch to increment `metrics.kv_meta_total` on create and decrement on meta free. Pushed to canary image: inference-runtime:meta-instrument-2027-03-12.

dev-bot: Deploying inference-runtime:meta-instrument-2027-03-12 to canary... started, 3/3 healthy.

alex: After ~4h on canary, metrics show meta_total > pages_in_use by ~8k and stays steady (not reclaimed). Logs show repeated warnings: `sweeper: skip removing meta id=0x7f8a3 because refcount>0` but refcount traces indicate zero.

rachel: That smells like ABA/refcount reuse: refcount was incremented after check due to racing path. Need a compare-and-swap in the sweeper or mark-and-sweep.

maria: Agreed. Also seeing `meta.owner_session` pointing to sessions that are already in `session_table` but marked closed; we don't clear owner when session closes in some edge cases (toolloop early-exit).

ken: I put together a minimal reproducer that exercises toolloop early-exit + async-evict. Repro steps in gist: https://gist.fake/repro-kv-meta-reuse. Repro reliably reproduces 2k orphan meta in ~30m.

priya: Proposed fix: when session closes we walk its owned meta ids and decrement safely (under session lock). Also change sweeper to use CAS on meta.state (LIVE -> PENDING_FREE -> FREE) to avoid races.

alex: Sounds good. Can we do a quick perf impact check? CAS path adds atomic ops on evict hotpath. If impact <2% latency p90 we're fine.

maria: I'll run microbenchmarks. Early numbers: p99 latency increase <0.5% on mock workload; CPU +1.2% in throughput benchmarks. Seems acceptable.

rachel: After applying the fix in a dev build and running the long soak, meta_total tracks pages_in_use closely and memory growth stops — looks resolved. Need PR + changelog + backport to last stable patch release.

maria: I'll draft PR with tests and add a kill-switch flag for `--kv-evict-sync=true` until the patch is rolled out. Also adding alert: kv_meta_free_lag > 5m.

tom: Great. Please add a small e2e that runs a short toolloop sequence and asserts meta_total == pages_in_use after GC. Add to CI longtests.

maria: Will do. Thanks everyone. Ending thread to track in issue: infra/kv/issue-5692. :thumbsup:
